subject: Supplier transition: credits, packaging options, and migration timing
content:
From: Paul Simmons <paul@bluewave.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, BlueWave Procurement <procurement@bluewave.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Supplier transition: credits, packaging options, and migration timing

Hi Kimberly,

Quick one — our current vendor just surfaced a retention offer (credits + 20% off first year) and procurement has asked us to get a formal written counter from any vendor were considering switching to.

High level: BlueWave runs inference-heavy features on 8 GPUs across staging/prod; current annual spend ~ $120k. We care about: migration assistance, data retention policies, SLA, and an apples-to-apples pricing comparison (tokens/embedding units + any fixed commitment or seat-like fees).

Can Redwood provide a succinct counterproposal that lays out:
- Packaging options (hosted vs dedicated vs private) with unit economics
- Any one-time migration credits or onboarding waivers you can offer
- SLA language or escalation path for enterprise
- If there are runtime/packaging constraints that affect total cost (e.g., minimum capacity for Dedicated)

If you can share something by end of day Friday (11/20) Procurement will consider it alongside the incumbent offer. Happy to hop on a 30-min call if easier.

Thanks,
Paul
Paul Simmons
Head of Infrastructure
BlueWave Analytics

---
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Paul Simmons <paul@bluewave.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Supplier transition: credits, packaging options, and migration timing

Thanks Paul — appreciate the heads-up.

We're preparing a short counterproposal and an economics workbook that maps your current usage to our packaging. I'm attaching an initial workbook (redwood_switch_workbook_v1.xlsx) — it includes a baseline hosted estimate and two Dedicated commitment tiers.

Couple quick clarifying Qs that will help us land the best offer:
- Can you share the incumbents total first-year effective price (after credits/discounts) or a redacted invoice?
- Do you need VPC/private deployment or is bluewave comfortable starting on Hosted with a migration path to Dedicated later?
- Any regulatory/audit requirements beyond SOC2 we should include in the proposal?

We can do a 30-min sync on Friday 11/20 — I have 11:00–12:00 or 16:00–17:00 PT open. Which works?

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_switch_workbook_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 48KB)

---
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 11:23:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Supplier transition: credits, packaging options, and migration timing

Internal — quick proposal guidance: 
- Baseline offer: 12-month committed term with standard 15% first-year volume discount for Hosted.
- Migration credit: offer a one-time credit equal to 10% of expected ARR (applied to first invoice); this is our usual play when incumbents surface matchup credits.
- Dedicated variant: 3-month free trial (credits applied as usage offset) + waived onboarding fee (normally $7.5k) if they commit to a 12-month Dedicated pool.
- Packaging note: emphasize predictable unit economics for Dedicated vs variable for Hosted — include example TCO over 12 months in workbook.

Marcus, LMK if that margin math is acceptable and whether we can stretch to 12% migration credit for strategic accounts.

Thanks,
Neha
VP, Sales Strategy

---
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 13:09:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Supplier transition: credits, packaging options, and migration timing

Neha — margin check: 10% migration credit on a $120k ARR equates to $12k applied first-year. With a 15% discount on tokens (~$18k off on $120k) plus waived onboarding ($7.5k) our blended revenue would be ~ $82.5k net in year 1 assuming no uplift. That gets close to our lower threshold but still within acceptable range for strategic customers.

I'm okay approving the 10% credit + waived onboarding for this account. If Kimberly thinks BlueWave has expansion potential (>=20% in 12 months) we could consider the 12% migration credit flexibility.

Also recommend we include a 90-day SLA climbdown clause in the commercial terms to address procurement concerns about performance during cutover.

Marcus
Head of Revenue Ops

---
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Paul Simmons <paul@bluewave.com>
Cc: BlueWave Procurement <procurement@bluewave.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:42:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Supplier transition: credits, packaging options, and migration timing

Paul — thanks for the context and the deadline. Per internal alignment, heres our formal counterproposal summary (full PDF attached):

1) Commercial summary (12-month term)
   - Hosted (recommended initial path): 15% off list pricing for year 1; token + embedding rates aligned to the workbook; one-time migration credit: $10,000 applied to first invoice.
   - Dedicated (if they prefer reserved capacity): 3 months usage credit (applied as offsets over first 90 days) + onboarding fee waived ($7,500 waived) for 12-month Dedicated commitment.

2) Packaging/ops items
   - Migration services: free migration planning and one week of dedicated runbook support during cutover (remote). Additional SOWs quoted separately.
   - SLA: 99.9% uptime for Dedicated; 99.5% for Hosted with escalation path to our enterprise support engineers. Include 90-day temporary remediation plan clause for cutover risks.

3) Standard enterprise terms. Were happy to accept a single procurement redline around competitor-match triggers but will request a mutual cadence for notification (30-day notice + documentation of competing offer).

Call to action: Ive attached the full counterproposal (counterproposal_20261118.pdf) and a DocuSign link for standard 12-month Hosted and Dedicated term options. Would you like 11:00 PT or 16:00 PT for a 30-min call today to walk through the details?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: counterproposal_20261118.pdf (PDF, 72KB)
Link: https://docusign.net/link/XYZ-BlueWave-20261118

---
From: Paul Simmons <paul@bluewave.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: BlueWave Procurement <procurement@bluewave.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 17:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Supplier transition: credits, packaging options, and migration timing

Kimberly — appreciate the clear options and the fast turnaround. Procurement will review the PDF and the workbook. A few quick notes:
- They want a clear clause for competitive adjustments: if incumbent matches within 30 days, procurement needs a documented escalation path for price re-evaluation.
- Wed like a 11:00 PT sync today; Ill invite Procurement and Legal.

If we can get the DocuSign framework in place and the minor competitive-match language clarified, we can fast-track this to an approval committee next week.

Talk soon,
Paul
Head of Infrastructure, BlueWave Analytics

>

>
